text:
𝗦𝗞𝗬 𝟭𝟱-𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗙𝗜𝗙𝗧𝗬! 🔥

Suryakumar Yadav hits 60* off 21 (5 sixes, 6 fours); his fifty came in just 15 balls.
Mumbai chase 173 v Hyderabad, winning by 7 wkts in the SMAT opener.

Fastest SKY knock you've seen? 👇

#SMAT #Cricket

𝗦𝗞𝗬 𝗞𝗔 𝟭𝟱 𝗚𝗘𝗘𝗡𝗗 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗙𝗜𝗙𝗧𝗬! 🔥

👉 Suryakumar Yadav ne SMAT opener mein 21 gend par 60* thoke (5 chhakke, 6 chauke)
👉 Fifty sirf 15 gend mein aayi
👉 Mumbai ne Hyderabad ka 173 ka target 7 wicket se chase kiya
👉 Musheer Khan ne bhi 23 gend mein fifty lagayi

Kya Mumbai SMAT jeet sakti hai? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #SMAT #SuryakumarYadav
